What were the possible values of the memory loss / feeling dazed TBI questions?

```{r}
library(abcdutils)

original_tbi_names()

search_dd("tbi_1c")$"var_label" #"Was he/she dazed or did he/she have a gap in his/her memory from the injury?

search_dd("tbi_1c")$"notes" #1 = Yes; 0 = No
```

```{r}
mtbi_der_u_dls <- all_dls_h_ns$"mtbi_der_u_dls"
mtbi_val_u_dls <- all_dls_h_ns$"mtbi_val_u_dls"

mtbi_der_u_dls[[1]]$"d_pubertal"

mtbi_der_pubertal <- lapply(
    mtbi_der_u_dls,
    function(x) {
        x$"d_pubertal"$"data"
    }
)

mtbi_val_pubertal <- lapply(
    mtbi_val_u_dls,
    function(x) {
        x$"d_pubertal"$"data"
    }
)

mtbi_pubertal_1 <- rbind(mtbi_der_pubertal[[1]], mtbi_val_pubertal[[1]])
mtbi_pubertal_2 <- rbind(mtbi_der_pubertal[[2]], mtbi_val_pubertal[[2]])
mtbi_pubertal_3 <- rbind(mtbi_der_pubertal[[3]], mtbi_val_pubertal[[3]])
mtbi_pubertal_4 <- rbind(mtbi_der_pubertal[[4]], mtbi_val_pubertal[[4]])
mtbi_pubertal_5 <- rbind(mtbi_der_pubertal[[5]], mtbi_val_pubertal[[5]])

cors <- lapply(
    list(
        mtbi_pubertal_1,
        mtbi_pubertal_2,
        mtbi_pubertal_3,
        mtbi_pubertal_4,
        mtbi_pubertal_5
    ),
    function(x) {
        cor(x$"pubertal_status_p", x$"pubertal_status_y")
    }
) |> unlist()

cors

mtbi_pubertal_1 |> 
    ggplot(
        aes(x = pubertal_status_p, pubertal_status_y)
    ) +
    geom_jitter() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") + 
    theme_bw()
```
